description: We are Astrolog, a dynamic two-man creative studio specializing in 3D animation and interactive storytelling. Leveraging our skills in platforms like Roblox studio and Blender, we transform complex concepts into engaging, highly visual, and accessible narratives. Our work bridges the gap between technical space science and creative digital media, using captivating character animation to inspire the next generation of space explorers.
summary: Explore the legacy of space exploration across the Moon, Mars, and Eros. Last Signal began as a Roblox game and now has a public browser version for easy access. The Roblox experience is still playable.
details:
Last Signal is an interactive exploration of the stories left behind by human spaceflight. Visit historically grounded sites across the Moon, Mars, and asteroid Eros to discover what missions left behind, why the equipment was there, and what it taught us.

We first developed Last Signal as a Roblox game. When we reviewed the challenge’s public-access requirements, we decided to make a browser-based version the main submission so reviewers could explore the project through a public link without needing Roblox or an account. The Roblox game remains available to play as a companion experience.
